summary: Verified the Web Audio AnalyserNode regression risk on YOURFM Player. The new graph (createMediaElementSource -> AnalyserNode -> destination, with crossOrigin='anonymous' on <audio>) does NOT silence or stall playback. After clicking play-pause-btn, music-audio.paused=false and currentTime advanced 2.40s -> 5.90s over ~3s. Skip swapped the src AND the new track advanced 2.98s -> 6.49s. Navigating back via back-from-player-btn and reopening the same station resumed playback (9.01s -> 12.52s) with NO 'already connected' / createMediaElementSource error (sourceConnectedRef guard works as designed - source is reused, not recreated). Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, zero 'Analyser setup failed' warnings. Canvas element renders inside player-container and the rAF visualizer loop did not throw. All 6 acceptance criteria from the review request are GREEN.
critical_code_review_comments: Player.jsx setupAnalyser(): createMediaElementSource(audioRef.current) is correctly guarded by sourceConnectedRef so reopening the station (Player stays mounted, station.id is stable) does not throw 'HTMLMediaElement already connected'. Confirmed working in this run.

audioCtxRef is never closed on unmount. If/when the Player component is fully unmounted (e.g. moving Player out of an always-mounted layer), call audioCtxRef.current?.close() in a cleanup to free the audio device. Not a regression today but worth a small follow-up.

The visualizer rAF loop (animate) is started in a useEffect with empty deps and reads analyserRef.current each frame - good. It will silently no-op when analyser is null (e.g. setupAnalyser failed) which is the documented expected behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_AnalyserRegression via UI flow, then DELETE /api/stations/<id> for cleanup. DB ends at 0 user stations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Open station via [data-testid=station-name-<id>] (the inner clickable div), NOT the outer station-card (card itself has no click handler). feedfm-station selection is button-style with [data-testid^=feedfm-station-]; voice-select is a real <select>. music-audio is visibility:hidden so use state='attached'. Read paused/currentTime via page.evaluate, NOT via selector assertions. Sampling currentTime twice ~3s apart is a reliable proof that the Web Audio graph is not stalled in headless. The sourceConnectedRef pattern means you can safely click back-from-player-btn and reopen without recreating the source.
rca of the issue: N/A - no regression. The new Web Audio graph integrates cleanly: AudioContext is created lazily on first play (user gesture), resumed if suspended, and createMediaElementSource runs exactly once per <audio> element thanks to sourceConnectedRef. Feed.fm CDN's ACAO:* + crossOrigin='anonymous' on <audio> means the AnalyserNode can read the stream without tainting and without breaking playback.
